page.notes: Marginal notes read: "Ecclesiæ Romanæ regimen paulatim deflexit." (right, beside XI); "Episcopi & Presbyteri identitas ex Hieronymo asserta." (right, beside XII). The catchword "sio-" and the signature "B 3" are printed at the foot. Some marginal words are faint and uncertain.
